steps: Add thin poha in a wide pan. Dry roast on low flame till it is crisp. Keep it aside.
In the same pan heat oil. Add peanuts and roast till crisp.
Add cashew, roasted gram dal, dry coconut slices and roast for 3-4 minutes.
Then add raisin and roast till the raisins puff up. Keep the nuts aside.
In the same pan add mustard seeds and let it crackle.
Add green chili, curry leaves and saute till crisp and dry. Then add hing, turmeric, red chili powder, roasted nuts and mix well.
Now add nuts mixture to roasted poha along with salt, powdered sugar, aamchur powder and mix everything well.
Cool completely before storing; store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

travel.title: Diwali Fares Are Peaking: When to Book, When to Stop Waiting

travel.title: Auckland's Diwali Festival Returns October 31 With Fireworks, Sky Tower Lights
travel.excerpt: The free BNZ Auckland Diwali Festival takes over Aotea Square and Queen Street on October 31 and November 1, with the Sky Tower lit from October 23 and Sunday fireworks at 8:50pm.

carousel.title: White House Clears Labor Department Plan to Overhaul PERM Green Card Rules
carousel.excerpt: The proposed PERM modernization (RIN 1205-AC29) cleared OIRA review on October 23 and heads to the Federal Register, with recruitment standards, layoff rules and nondiscrimination requirements in scope.
carousel.image_caption: The White House in Washington, DC. The administration completed its review of the Labor Department's proposed PERM overhaul on October 23, clearing the proposal for publication in the Federal Register.
carousel.nri_angle: PERM is the first step for most EB-2 and EB-3 green cards, where Indian applicants are the largest group; the overhaul's recruitment and layoff rules will shape their filings once finalized.

carousel.title: PM-Kisan's 24th Instalment of Rs 2,000 Reaches Farmers on October 30
carousel.excerpt: The October 30 payout to about 9.3 crore farmers depends on three portal checks — eKYC, Aadhaar bank seeding and land seeding — as a re-verification drive flags over 31 lakh cases.
carousel.image_caption: Farmers in India (file photo). The 24th PM-Kisan instalment of Rs 2,000 is scheduled to reach beneficiary farmers on October 30.
carousel.nri_angle: NRI families with relatives farming in India need the beneficiary's eKYC, Aadhaar seeding and land records cleared before October 30 or the Rs 2,000 instalment is held.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

steps.detail: Go to pmkisan.gov.in and open the Farmers Corner section.
Enter your registration number and the captcha, then the OTP sent to your registered mobile.
Land Seeding, eKYC Done and Aadhaar Bank Seeding must all show Yes. Any No can hold the payment.
Complete eKYC on the PM-Kisan app or at a Common Service Centre; ask your bank to confirm Aadhaar seeding and NPCI mapping.
